aiMetadata.description: Creates an eSignatures contract from an existing template and, by default, sends it to the listed signers for signature; set save-as-draft to create it without sending. Use when an agent needs to issue a document for signing. Requires a valid template ID and at least one signer (name plus email and/or mobile). Not idempotent: each call creates and dispatches a new contract.
